user_questions.question: When a Case has a storefront, how should Business Account be filled? (A) Only when Business Account is blank, on create and on update, never overwriting an existing value [recommended]; (B) Always sync from the storefront on create and whenever the storefront changes, overwriting manual or caller-supplied values (AgentCaseCreateActions passes businessAccountId); (C) Only on create when blank. Evidence: no automation on Case today; 4 existing Cases have a storefront and blank business account.
